wiki.title: Alex Lee (politician)
wiki.extract: Alex Tinming Lee (born July 11, 1995) is an American politician who has served as a member of the California State Assembly since 2020, having represented the 24th district since 2022 and the 25th district from 2020 to 2022. A member of the Democratic Party, Lee's district includes Fremont, Newark, Sunol, Milpitas, and parts of eastern San Jose.
